resources.string: Volume buttons broken? Use the floating bubble.
Android needs the \"Display over other apps\" permission so the bubble can stay on top of other apps.
A small bubble stays on screen. Tap it for volume controls, drag it anywhere.
On OPPO/ColorOS, allow this app in Settings → Battery → App battery management → Allow background activity, otherwise the system may kill the bubble.
Make the bubble more or less transparent. Changes apply immediately and are remembered.
How opaque the black volume panel is. Text, sliders and buttons stay fully opaque; only the panel background changes.
The bubble restarts itself after a reboot or an app update. If it does not, open the ColorOS autostart switch below.
Open Settings → Apps → Autostart manually and enable Floaty Volume.

Android lets you close apps from the Recents screen, and no app can stop that. Two ways to keep the bubble up:

• Lock it in Recents: swipe up, long-press the Floaty Volume card, tap Lock. It can no longer be swiped away.

• Add the home-screen widget: it lives in the launcher, so it survives an app kill. Tap its title to bring the bubble back, or use its − / + buttons to change volume directly.
Volume panel that survives app kills. Tap the title to start the bubble; use − / + to adjust each stream.
Tap the bubble to change volume
Tap a row to target it with + / −
